{"notes": "VISIT 2 (ending 3:30). Ratings still provisional; I still don't know who placed which dominoes, so no one gets credit or blame for the picture itself.

TABLE STATE: Big progress since visit 1. Everything shown is connected to the start. The upper line now runs unbroken from the start to about x=26.5, so the gap at x=10 is closed (I don't know who fixed it). The lower line runs to x~27 and curves up the right side to about (25,10). One open gap remains on the right, roughly 5 units between the upper line's end (26.5,5) and the lower curve's end (25,10). The fish outline can't close until someone covers it. The strokes do join at the start. No hands were shown at the table.

JACK: At 3:00 he said the lower tail was done and that he'd check the joins around the fork, then asked Omar for status. His claim matches the table: the lower line is complete and smooth. Good ownership and good cross-checking. Collaboration looks strong. Not yet seen: whether he spots the right-side gap.

OMAR: At 3:15 he gave a clear, specific status: upper tail halfway round the tip, then on to the notch. I can't match that to the table, since the upper line looks connected throughout. Ask him on the next visit what's left and where. He communicates reliably, but I can't verify his execution.

HANA: No direct evidence this visit. The upper body she claimed is connected, which is consistent, but I didn't see her work or hear her. Ask whether she owns the right-side gap.

SOFIA: Still not seen or heard, and no one mentioned her. No evidence, so no penalty. Ask her privately what she's working on and how the team is working. Check whether anyone owns the right-side gap.

TO DO: Find out who owns the gap at the right (head). Check that the upper and lower lines meet cleanly."}
